title: Just starting, and I'm done
alt: Two sisters in graduation caps and gowns walk away from the camera holding hand-lettered signs reading "JUST STARTING!" and "I'M DONE", string lights overhead.

title: Honor sash, golden hour
alt: A graduate in a white dress and gold honor sash smiles over her shoulder, backlit by golden hour sun.

title: Roses and golden light
alt: A young woman in a blue-and-white dress holds a bouquet of white roses, pink blossoms framing her face, backlit by warm porch light.

title: Stopping to smell the roses
alt: Close-up of a young woman smelling a bouquet of white roses, warm golden-hour light in her hair.

title: Stone wall, golden hour
alt: A young woman in a white dress and cowboy boots leans against a stone wall, glancing back over her shoulder in warm evening light.

title: Leaning on the fence
alt: A young woman in a white dress leans against a stone wall, hair caught by the wind, a building softly blurred behind her.

title: Quiet moment, golden light
alt: A young woman in a white dress leans against a sunlit stone wall, looking down at her bracelet, soft lens flare across the frame.

title: Roses on cobblestone
alt: A young woman in a white dress sits on cobblestone pavement holding white roses, golden hour light behind her.
